Nadia (CS): Heads-up: TundraBank expects a traffic surge Mon 08:00-10:00 PT after a headline drop. Forecast shows ~38% above their dedicated quota. Need a short mitigation plan: autoscale guardrail, provisional burst capacity, a 20m validation run, and a rollback play. Who can own what?

Ibrahim (Eng): I can own autoscale + fallback. Propose trigger p95 > 270ms, max burst +40%, fallback to quant-small-qtz. I'll draft a tiny yaml and PR.

Sofia (Infra): I can provision burst slots once billing signs off. Need quota token and exact prep window. Zone affinity may apply.

Noah (SRE): I'll write a minimal runbook with prechecks and a rollback snippet. Rollback pattern: route traffic off Dedicated pool, disable autoscale, failover to hosted. I'll add a brief chaos probe step.

Pri (PDE): I'll run the 20m soak (start 08:15 PT) and post latency histograms + 5xx traces. Load profile: 9k RPS, ~60% long-gen. Using loadgen and a short sampler for KV hits.

ops-bot: Job scheduled -> load-tundra-1765440200. CI: https://ci.internal/lt-tundra-1765440200 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Nadia (CS): Quota token TB-2026-Q2. Prep window 07:30-10:30 PT. Billing @billing looped in. Renewal: hold auto-renew until we validate headroom; risk = medium if we can't show stable ramp.

Ibrahim (Eng): Draft autoscale snippet I'll PR today. Will include alerts for p95, 5xx rate, and queue-depth.

Sofia (Infra): Billing approved provisional burst 07:30-10:30 PT. I'll provision and post slot IDs by EOD.

Noah (SRE): Runbook link (draft): https://confluence.internal/tundra/dedicated-mitigation. Rollback snippet to include:
redwood route update --customer tundra --pool default
redwood autoscale update --customer tundra --enabled false
I'll add paging matrix and healthcheck commands.

Pri (PDE): After staging shadow run I'll upload artifacts (latency hist, sample failures, KV-hit logs).

Nadia (CS): Owners recap: Ibrahim -> autoscale PR + fallback (EOD); Sofia -> provision slots + IDs (EOD); Pri -> run Mon 08:15 PT and post results; Noah -> finalize runbook & chaos probe (Mon 06:00 PT); Nadia -> customer comms and renewal hold. Reconvene Sun 16:00 PT for go/no-go.

Ibrahim (Eng): +1 :thumbsup:

Pri (PDE): Will post results here after the shadow run.

ops-bot: Reminder -> load-tundra job 1765440200 will start in 24h.

Nadia (CS): Final note: log any anomalies to ticket TUNDRA-321 and escalate to #incidents if 5xx spikes or latency breaches SLA.
